privacy.telemetryLabel: Telemetry means automatic usage reports. Gostman sends none.
privacy.docsLink: Link to the documentation page that lists every network connection.
privacy.updatesLabel: Setting that lets the app look for a newer version on GitHub.
privacy.updateAvailable: Status bar text. {{version}} is a version number.
privacy.updateHint: Tooltip of the status bar item.
privacy.relayLabel: Setting for how the web app sends requests: through the hosted relay server or a relay on the local computer.
privacy.relayModes.hosted: Option: the relay run by the Gostman website.
privacy.relayModes.local: Option: a relay started on this computer with the command gostman relay.
privacy.relayAddressHint: Keep the command "gostman relay" as written.
privacy.relayCheck: Button that tests whether the relay answers.
privacy.relayMissing: Preferences, Privacy are names of the settings page and section.
